name: NeXgen
description: The NeXgen engine for OpenClaw: the guardrail before a tool call, the vault briefing after a compaction, the /quota, /council and /sup commands, the supervision tools the supervisor agent drives, the evidence check on local models, and a notice when the Skill Workshop learns a skill. The policy lives in nexgen-guardrail.config.json and nexgen.config.json, read on every call.
